title: Clip file names carry the section letter, length and key from key over time
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Clip file names carry the section letter, length and key

  Scenario: The key comes from key over time
    Given an analyzed march in Bb whose trio (from 60 s) is in Eb
    And a saved clip "trio-riff" from 64 s to 66 s
    When I export its sidecars
    Then its file is named with key "Eb"

  Scenario: A clip across a modulation takes the key where most of it lies
    Given a saved clip covering 1 s in Bb and 3 s in Eb
    When I export its sidecars
    Then its file is named with key "Eb"

  Scenario: No section letter when the sample has no sections
    Given an analyzed drum stem with a saved clip "loop-1" one bar long and no sections
    When I export its sidecars
    Then its file is named "1bar loop-1.alc"

  Scenario: No key for unpitched or uncertain audio
    Given an analyzed drum stem whose key strength is below the naming threshold
    When I export its sidecars
    Then no clip file name contains a key

  Scenario: No length for an unwarped sample
    Given the analyzed fixture sample "free-time.wav" with a saved clip "phrase-1"
    When I export its sidecars
    Then its file is named "phrase-1.alc"
    And that clip file has warping off
```
